source: The fix-it plan's S7, its four blind cases, their expectations written on 2026-11-12 before any run (none has been made). Each pack is captured from the host by `scripts/nmas-fixit-cases --capture`, never typed, and the expectations are not changed after a run sees them.
bar: PHASE8_PLAN 15.12: the blind set at a floor of 85% of its runs passing.

cases.title: B1: another device's lost stream, its first incident
cases.awaiting: an incident on another device whose telemetry stream was lost, captured on the host

cases.title: B2: the collector's listener down (a gap)
cases.awaiting: an incident while nothing listens on the stream's port on the collector (Mercury's diagnosis collector_down)

cases.title: B3: a receiver a run left removed (telemetry-readd)
cases.awaiting: an incident after a run left a receiver removed (`resubscribe.removed_now`), captured before the re-add

cases.title: B4: a stream lost seconds after its cause cleared (wait)
cases.awaiting: an incident captured within the settle window after its cause cleared (Mercury's diagnosis cause_just_cleared)
